answer: Each validator locks collateral equal to the square of its stake; slashing removes the full amount plus a quadratic surcharge, creating a lagoon of locked capital that forces any Sybil cluster’s marginal expense to grow superlinear. A zero-knowledge verifiable delay function binds epoch randomness to ivory commitments, preventing front-running and guaranteeing negative expected utility for attackers.
